title: The Duck King's Ring
objectives_ko: ck(/k/)·ng(/ŋ/)가 두 글자 한 소리라는 것을 알고 말한다
ck·ng 단어 8개(duck sock rock lock ring king wing song)를 소리를 이어 읽고 그림과 잇고 쓴다
사이트워드 what, are를 보고 읽고, 배운 단어로 된 문장 4개를 읽는다

workbook.title: C. Read and circle.  D. Trace the sentence.

sentences.text: The duck is on the rock.
A ring is in the sock.
The king can sing a song.

story.title: The Duck King's Ring

panels.desc: A sunny pond in the middle of the Pair Forest. A small yellow duck wearing a tiny golden crown — the Duck King — sits sadly on a big grey rock in the water, holding up one empty wing. On the bank stands a small wooden door with a golden padlock on it; the two letters c and k are carved on the door — the ONLY text allowed in the picture. Bun points at the padlock; Hedgie scratches his head; Pip says the two letters apart; Pim and Pam sit on the door frame. A red-and-white striped sock hangs on a reed. Hidden in the picture: the duck, the rock, the padlock, the striped sock, the little king with his crown. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: 숲속 연못, 작은 왕관을 쓴 오리 왕이 바위 위에서 슬퍼해요. 둑에는 자물쇠 달린 c·k 문. 핍은 "크… 크…"

panels.desc: Pim and Pam say the sound together with one sharp click, and the golden padlock pops open and falls; the little door swings open. Inside is a tiny round room full of socks hanging on lines, and in the middle hangs one red-and-white striped sock with something glinting inside it. Beads holds up three beads; Bun and Hedgie lean in; the Duck King flaps over hopefully. Hidden in the picture: the open padlock, the socks, the duck.
panels.ko: 핌과 팜이 함께 /k/! 딸깍, 자물쇠가 열려요. 문 안은 양말이 가득한 작은 방! 줄무늬 양말 하나가 반짝여요.

panels.desc: Hedgie pulls the striped sock off its line and turns it upside down: a small gold ring with a blue gem drops into his paw, sparkling. Pim and Pam hum the sound together and the ring rings like a tiny bell, little sound waves around it; Pip, beak open, tries and says the two letters apart again; the Duck King claps his wings. Hidden in the picture: the ring, the sock, the little king with his crown, his wings.

lines.text: Look! A ring in a sock!

panels.ko: 헤지가 양말을 뒤집자 파란 보석 반지가 툭! 핌과 팜이 함께 /ŋ/~ 반지가 종처럼 울려요. 핍은 또 "느… 그…"

panels.desc: The Duck King wears the ring on a ribbon around his neck, stands tall on the rock and spreads both wings wide, singing a happy song with colorful music notes floating up. Bun and Hedgie dance on the bank; Pim and Pam sing along; Beads sways. Up in the tree, Grumble leans over his branch with a paw at his mouth, but his eyes are closed and his foot taps to the song. Hidden in the picture: the duck, the ring, the wings, the song notes, the little king, the rock.

lines.text: The king can sing a song!

panels.ko: 오리 왕이 반지를 목에 걸고 날개를 활짝 펴 노래해요. 나무 위 그럼블은 "쉿!" 하면서도 발을 까딱까딱.

story.synopsis_ko: 오리 왕의 반지가 자물쇠 달린 c·k 문 안에 있어요. 핌과 팜이 /k/! 자물쇠가 열리고 양말 방에서 반지를 찾아요. /ŋ/~ 반지가 종처럼 울리고, 오리 왕이 노래해요. 나무 위 그럼블도 발을 까딱까딱.
story.so_far_ko: 가느다란 오솔길의 th 문을 열고, 진흙에 빠진 그럼블에게 거품 목욕을 해 줬어요.
story.goal_ko: ck /k/ 와 ng /ŋ/ 를 말해 자물쇠를 열고 오리 왕의 반지를 찾아요.
